notes.title: Streetdog BMX Development Update
notes.content: [p]Yo! Sorry for the massive lack of updates, but I’m still alive and I’m still working on the game![/p][p][/p][p]Those of you on the Discord ( [url="https://discord.gg/RBk8We8RQ9"]https://discord.gg/RBk8We8RQ9[/url] ) will have heard this already, but for everyone else:[/p][p][/p][p]I’m still cracking on with the game, and I’m very much in the polish phase - making sure all the levels are jam packed with fun stuff to ride and interesting spots to discover. After that I need to polish all of the challenges, and then it’s on to final bug fixing and then finally release! The exact release timing is still up in the air, but I’m currently aiming for the end of the summer on PC, around September time. This is not final and things may change etc etc, but it works as a very rough estimate of when to expect the full game to drop. I’ve had a little set back on the console side of things - my (ex) publisher Null has shut down all of their publishing operations, so I’m back to working on the game totally solo. For those that don't know, I've been a solo dev (previous games include Pumped BMX and Trailboss BMX) for most of my 'career', but this game is a much bigger game than any of those games were. So you might need to bear with me a bit while I figure out how to manage it all by myself! [/p][p][/p][p]As for what I’ve been doing recently, this week I’ve been working on the final level in the game. This is a wild level with some nice technical lines, but some really massive gaps and drops too. These levels have all been mostly done for quite a while, but based on the craziness I’ve seen people do in the demo I’ve been slowly going back through all the levels and beefing up the available lines. I’m [i]nearly[/i] done with this last level, then I’m going to be going back through all the challenges and making sure they all work with the extra features etc. Then there's a little more work to do on the cosmetic stuff, then testing, more testing, etc etc etc![/p][p][/p][p]Now that’s I’m back to managing all the Steam stuff solo (which I’m still finding my way around!), I’ll try and post more of these updates here to keep you in the loop. But for more info and chat head over to the Discord![/p][p][/p][p]Nice one, Ads x[/p]

notes.title: Streetdog BMX Update - Playtest coming soon!
notes.content:
Yo!

Adam here, just wanted to give a few updates on Streetdog BMX as we head toward the end of the year. This year has been insane - we’ve made huge progress with levels, physics, art, challenges - all of it! It’s shaping up to be a banger.

However, as I’m sure many of you have guessed, we’ve made the decision to push releasing Streetdog BMX into 2025. 

Why? Well, we want to give it more polish, better challenges, smoother gameplay and fewer bugs. We want to give you the best possible BMX game we can make, and delaying a few months will allow us to do that.

Of course, a delay with the goal of making SDBMX better means we need more player feedback, so… starting soon, we’re kicking off an official [b]Community Steam Playtest[/b] for Streetdog BMX! 

Everyone who is accepted to the playtest will have access to the initial ‘Training Ground’ map and tutorials, along with the ‘core’ set of tricks and controls. In this playtest we’ll be collecting feedback on physics, controls, and the general tutorial flow - this is your chance to really make a direct impact on SDBMX.

To sign up for the playtest, [url=https://discord.gg/streetdogbmx]join our Discord[/url] and click the signup link, and we’ll be in touch.

You all deserve a great BMX game. Help us make one. Join the playtest!

notes.title: Play Streetdog BMX At The X Games!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2707870/Streetdog_BMX/]Streetdog BMX[/url] is coming to the [url=https://www.xgames.com/events/x-games-ventura-2024]X Games[/url]! That’s right, we’re bringing the latest and greatest version of the game to Ventura, California, where attendees will get a chance to get their hands on Streetdog BMX - potentially for the very first time. 

We’re all really excited to show off Streetdog BMX to all the attendees of the X Games and we’ll have plenty of stations set up to do so. If you come over to [url=https://cdn.sanity.io/images/uj4029y4/production/6a3ab082083d0d228ab227abbb1c59f1d6717fac-2200x1699.jpg?auto=format]Venue A[/url] (near the Street Park and Moto courses), you’ll find the Streetdog BMX tent near the X Games Merch Store. [url=https://www.instagram.com/pumpedbmx/]Adam Hunt[/url], the game’s developer, and popular BMX Youtuber [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCqfKKVcH2o7IBMrofAr7AsA]The Old Potato[/url] will be on hand to help you get started playing and answer any questions you might have!

In addition, we’ll have some X Games-exclusive goodies to give away, so please do come by the Streetdog BMX tent and give the game a whirl! The tent will be open from 10 AM to 8 PM every day, so you’ll have plenty of time to try the game out in between seeing sequential 900s in the Vert Park and 100 foot jumps at the Moto area. We'll see you there, we hope. If you can't make it, please keep an eye on the [url=https://linktr.ee/streetdogbmx]Streetdog BMX social accounts[/url] for pictures and updates from the event.
